assumption: The next actual ordinary-program request is file-backed SEC_IMAGE with access0xD, page0x10, flags0x01000000, no maximum pointer and the retained VERSION.dll handle.
basis: Fresh file-section-frontier-v1 owning observation and both ordinary owning routes at file-open candidate2.
stress-test: Re-run both actual owning routes and native controls after implementation.
falsification-probe: A fresh ordinary route fails before this call or arguments differ.

assumption: An image view must retain section/backing authority after its caller file and section handles close.
basis: Accepted independent v10/v15 native controls close caller file and Section handles before image queries/reads; compiled portable and native installed-leaf tests retain the view until unmap. Native controls also observe deletion failure while mapped, but no complete guest deletion contract is claimed.
stress-test: Close caller file/section handles, replace/rename pathname, map/unmap aliases and inspect original data.
falsification-probe: Native lifetime controls or compiled resource counts disagree with the proposed retention.

assumption: Native SEC_IMAGE file access depends on PAGE protection; requested section grants alone do not grant file authority.
basis: Accepted v2/v3 independent controls, including77file-grant/protection combinations per ABI view.
dependent-result: Shared rights validation before acquiring image backing.
stress-test: Read-only, execute-only, zero and write grants against all seven accepted PAGE bases.
falsification-probe: Independent native matrix disagrees on grant/status ordering.

assumption: Reported maximum size and rounded mapped extent must remain distinct.
basis: Native v3 maximum1 reports basic size1 but maps4096bytes; default native image size90112bytes and WoW32size32768bytes.
dependent-result: Partial image creation, metadata and mapping geometry.
falsification-probe: Basic information or mapped extent differs from the independent cases.

assumption: Portable Windows capture owns the retained file cursor under scheduler serialization.
basis: Guest kernel dispatch holds exclusive mutable process state; this adapter receives the process-owned File. Rust seek_read changes the cursor, unlike Unix read_at.
stress-test: Success and short/error reads; caller position7 is preserved by the compiled test on all hosts.
falsification-probe: An embedder concurrently seeks an externally cloned host file during capture; such external alias ownership would require synchronization beyond guest scheduling.
